The discipline is the differentiator, measured baselines, bounded scopes, and decisions you can replay a year later. For Agriculture & Food Systems, that discipline is not optional, it is the engagement model.

For the Blockchain & Digital Trust side of Agriculture & Food Systems, the binding duties are concrete, EUDR (deforestation-free due diligence with geolocation evidence for in-scope commodities); Digital Product Passport (EU) (product-level data duties approaching for food-adjacent goods); Food-safety regimes (HACCP/EU 178/FSMA) (traceability and recall duties). We design against them from the first sprint so the audit reads the system, not a binder.
